answer: Denominate the registration bond in externally-locked capital — bridged SOL or USDC frozen in single-use escrow — not in minted protocol coin. This closes the circular inlet where emission rewards fund the next wave of personas. An honest agent locks one outside deposit and earns it back through graded labor. An operator fielding a thousand fakes must source a thousand independent external locks, each a real ember of outside money forfeit if its persona produces no work, and none recyclable across the mesa of clones since every lock is spent once.
